scope: Declared selected-contrast metadata preflight against pinned current wrappers; no fitting or execution authorization
source_snapshot: Isolated T08 upstream and algorithm baseline; not a claim about every published method or current nf-core release
selection_policy: Only user-declared rows; never generate all condition pairs

bulk_complete.boundary: Independent selected two-condition contrasts only. Complete-bundle input gate rejects paired, batch, covariate and interaction models. Native fit, reference, input and resource qualification remain required.

deseq2_adapter.formula_family: Intercept plus additive categorical condition and optional batch and/or subject
deseq2_adapter.boundary: Native R DEG adapter exists with full-rank/residual-df checks and complete subject-pair checks. Extended designs are not exposed by the complete-bundle entry gate. A valid metadata preflight does not make this an integrated execution route. No interaction, arbitrary numeric covariate, nonlinear term or mixed model.

import_only.allowed_terms_semantics: Empty because source model text is preserved as opaque provenance; it is not parsed, evaluated or substituted with a simpler model
import_only.paired_flag_semantics: No local paired computation is provided; a declared native paired result may still be imported without claiming local reproducibility
import_only.boundary: Validate identity and declared effect direction, preserve original declared row, native pairing/model fields and P/FDR. Import does not certify source-model correctness, assay eligibility, independent replication or successful new computation.
import_only.sample_scope_semantics: Selected sample IDs describe comparison arms only; they do not establish all samples used in the original native statistical fit.

deseq2.statistics_policy: Native P, BH-adjusted P, test status and tested universe are preserved. Metadata validation does not fit DESeq2.

dexseq_exon.direction_exception: Do not assign treatment-minus-control to a native fold-change column merely because the user selected that comparison. Current export records control-over-treatment with the native column header authoritative. Gene-level perGeneQValue is unsigned.
dexseq_exon.design_boundary: Current upstream script retains sample and condition only; additional batch/donor columns do not adjust the fitted model.

dexseq_dtu_stager.native_name: DRIMSeq filtering, DEXSeq DTU, stageR adjustment
dexseq_dtu_stager.direction_exception: Native DEXSeq fold-change header is authoritative; gene and stageR q-values have no effect direction.
dexseq_dtu_stager.design_boundary: Current upstream DEXSeq script consumes sample plus condition and selected pair rows. DRIMSeq is used for filtering, not an independent dmFit/dmTest differential result.

rmats.contrast_binding: group1=treatment; group2=control; preserve JC/JCEC and declared sample-vector order
rmats.design_boundary: Vendored module exposes --paired-stats, but the current complete workflow passes false. It provides no batch/covariate/interaction model. No automatic donor pairing.

suppa.contrast_binding: Adapter places control first and treatment second; native output is treatment-minus-control. Preserve original input-order provenance.
suppa.design_boundary: Vendored module exposes -pa, but the complete workflow passes false. Arbitrary batch/covariate/interaction models are not implemented by this wrapper.

dexseq_interaction.design: Explicit independent 2x2 with two categorical factors, explicit reference levels and at least two independent samples per cell; optional batch usage terms
dexseq_interaction.statistic: Native DEXSeq full-versus-reduced likelihood-ratio test, removing the declared interaction term; BH across tested exon bins
dexseq_interaction.boundary: Existing dedicated adapter, not the complete upstream route or the thin T11 contrast dispatcher. No paired donor model or mixed model. Exon-bin fractions are descriptive and are not rMATS PSI. Real-data and simulation acceptance are still required.

source_evidence.claim: Complete-bundle gate accepts only ~ condition, independent biological replicas and explicit treatment/control comparisons; extended designs are rejected.
DEG adapter supports only additive categorical condition/batch/subject with native rank/residual-df and complete-pair checks; native DESeq2 contrast is treatment/control.
Current complete route passes false to rMATS/SUPPA paired flags; export preserves DEXSeq direction exception and SUPPA input-order provenance.
Exon DEU wrapper retains only sample/condition, selects declared pairs and invokes native DEXSeq.
Transcript DTU wrapper consumes two-column sample/condition metadata and declared pairs.
Native rMATS pin and optional paired flag exist in the vendored module, separately from complete-route wiring.
SUPPA pin and optional paired flag exist in the vendored module, separately from complete-route wiring.
Existing formal opt-in workflow identity, explicit 2x2 scope and pending real-data/simulation acceptance.
Independent 2x2 design validation, explicit references, replicate counts and unique count files.
Native full/reduced interaction models, optional batch usage terms, rank checks, LRT and complete-family BH.
Existing estimability utility uses native NumPy rank/row-space diagnostics but enumerates contrasts; T11 must not invoke its all-pairs generator.

public_artifact_note: Evidence paths are relative identifiers of the isolated source snapshot. These source copies are not installed as part of the thin contract resource; no machine paths, data, credentials or native results are included.
